title: Panoramic Bay Window Master Suite
tagline: Curved bay sitting alcove with timber slatted ceiling canopy and warm indirect glow
description: An intimate bedroom retreat built around a panoramic picture window with built-in bay seating. The bed headboard flows into a timber slat accent wall that wraps seamlessly onto the ceiling with recessed cove light ribbons.

details.Features: Curved Window Bay Bench, Wrapped Timber Slat Ceiling, Tufted Low-profile Bed
